My memory only partly settles this. The owner rejected both options offered for Angular/webpack-style toolchains ("What cawco plugin now?"). He also rejected the webpack option: "Just use ur own canvas with some html or json or whatever? Cmon". So projects without a plugin should get CawCo's own canvas, not a toolchain-specific integration.

Fable wrote the spec (docs/specs/live-components-c.md), and the owner said "Ok do C". It was built as slice 1 (be171c45) using CSF story sheets at /@cawco/sheet. It refuses Vite<6, Angular, Astro, Nuxt and Next. I did not find the exact final design for no-plugin projects.
